turns.assessment: The failure boundary is at the input of OMS S10->S02: even booster amp0 lost input power, while every amplifier downstream lost both input and output and the reverse OMS S02->S10 remained normal. Stable pump-current telemetry argues strongly against amplifier failure, and the hard all-channel loss plus recent S10 maintenance favors a disconnected/broken input patch over contamination.

proposals.rationale: A pulled input patch at S10 directly explains loss at amp0 input and the resulting loss across every downstream amplifier and channel on OMS S10->S02. The unaffected reverse direction localizes the fault to this unidirectional input, and recent S10 maintenance increases its likelihood.
Contamination at the same patch is plausible after maintenance, but normally causes reduced power rather than the observed complete loss.
